title: known leftover: arm_swipe_beat re-arms a 20 ms timer chain beside the SwipeMachine's own gesture state
trigger: swipe a chat row sideways with the trackpad, then stop sending events mid-gesture
effect: beat keeps waking (50 Hz) until the machine's 600 ms stale rule ends the gesture; ends by itself, no stuck state
fix: drive the swipe settle from the frame clock (request_animation_tick) and drop SwipePoll

title: SuggestUi::dismissed is written on Esc and never cleared, so the same query stays suppressed in later messages and other chats
trigger: type `:fire` (emoji popup shows), press Esc, send the message (or switch chat), type `:fire` again at the same offset
effect: the emoji popup closes exactly at the previously dismissed query and stays hidden until the text changes; stickers_dismissed beside it is cleared when its text stops matching, dismissed never is
fix: hold the dismissal in SuggestStage (e.g. Dismissed{query}) so a stage change, send, or ChatUi swap drops it, like stickers_dismissed

title: CreateRefusal::Own returns from submit_new_community with no note and no Creating step
trigger: Create community, press Create, close the box before the answer, reopen New community for the same chat and press Create
effect: the button does nothing (no spinner, no error) until the first request answers; the later Created outcome only shows a toast and leaves the new box open
fix: on Own, enter CreateStep::Creating with the driver's request (or show the busy note) so the box matches the request that is out

title: settle_scheduled_deletes drops the refetch error after a refused delete, leaving the optimistically removed row gone
trigger: delete a scheduled message while the server refuses (or offline) and the get_chat_scheduled_messages resend also fails
effect: error toast shows but the scheduled list still lacks the message until the box is reopened
fix: hold the refetch as ScheduledLoad::Loading(request) in the box so a failed refetch shows Failed with Retry instead of a silent let _ =
